result.topic_en: Derivation of four new spherical-trigonometric formulas (Gauss's analogies / Delambre-type formulas) relating half-angles and half-sides of a spherical triangle, starting from the cosine rule.
result.transcription:
Ableitung der vier neuen trigonometrischen Formeln.

$\cos a = \cos b\cos c + \sin b\sin c\cos A$
$\cos(b+c) = \cos b\cos c - \sin b\sin c$
$\cos(b-c) = \cos b\cos c + \sin b\sin c$

1. $\sin\frac12(a+b+c)\sin\frac12(b+c-a) = \sin b\sin c\cos\frac12 A^2$
2. $\sin\frac12(a+b-c)\sin\frac12(a-b+c) = \sin b\sin c\sin\frac12 A^2$

$\sin\frac12 A\sin\frac12(b+c-a) = \sin r\sin\alpha$
$\sin(\mathfrak{b}+\gamma)\sin CM = \sin\frac12 B\sin a$
$\sin r = \sin CM\sin\frac12 C$
$\cos\frac12 A = \cos r\sin\alpha$
$\mathrm{tang}\frac12 A\sin\frac12(b+c-a) = \mathrm{tang}\, r$

3. $\sin\frac12 A\sin\frac12(b+c-a) = \sin\frac12 B\sin\frac12 C\sin a$
$\sin\frac12 B\sin\frac12 C\sin a\sin\frac12(a+b+c) = \sin b\sin c\cos\frac12 A^2\sin\frac12 A$
$\sin b\sin c\sin A^2 = \sin B\sin C\sin a^2$

4. $\sin\frac12 A\sin\frac12(b+c+a) = \cos\frac12 B\cos\frac12 C\sin a$

$\sin\frac12 B\sin\frac12(a+c-b) = \sin\frac12 A\sin\frac12 C\sin b$
$\sin A\sin b = \sin B\sin a$

5. $\cos\frac12 A\sin\frac12(a+c-b) = \cos\frac12 B\sin\frac12 C\sin a$
6. $\cos\frac12 A\sin\frac12(a+b-c) = \sin\frac12 B\cos\frac12 C\sin a$

7. $\cos\frac12 A\sin\frac12(b-c) = \sin\frac12(B-C)\sin\frac12 a$ aus 6 − 5
8. $\sin\frac12 A\sin\frac12(b+c) = \cos\frac12(B-C)\sin\frac12 a$ aus 4 + 3
9. $\cos\frac12 A\cos\frac12(b-c) = \sin\frac12(B+C)\cos\frac12 a$ aus 6 + 5
10. $\sin\frac12 A\cos\frac12(b+c) = \cos\frac12(B+C)\cos\frac12 a$ aus 4 − 3
